prompt:
Sprite sheet for a 2D adventure game. The character is the badger courier from the first reference image, a character sheet: keep exactly his costume, colours, body proportions and drawing style (clean dark outlines, flat colour fills with soft cel shading, hand-painted cartoon look); ignore its layout with three views and its magenta background. Neutral even light from the front-top, no rim light, no cast shadow, no ground. Not a 3D render, not plush, not a photograph.
The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.
Layout: one single horizontal row of 8 animation frames of one walk cycle, evenly spaced across the full width, the badger seen exactly from the side, facing right, in every frame, the soles of the feet on the same baseline. The 8 phases in order from left to right: 1 contact – near leg stretched forward with the heel touching down, far leg stretched back on its toes; 2 down – weight on the near leg, knees bent, body at its lowest; 3 passing – the far leg swings forward past the standing near leg; 4 up – body at its highest, pushing off from the near toes; 5 contact – far leg stretched forward with the heel touching down, near leg stretched back; 6 down – weight on the far leg; 7 passing – the near leg swings forward past the standing far leg; 8 up. Every frame is a different pose, no two frames are the same. In every frame the parcel stays tucked under the near arm, the free far arm swings opposite to the legs, the scarf ends trail behind him.
Every frame is a complete, separate drawing of the whole character at the same scale; clear empty space between neighbouring frames, nothing touching or overlapping, no frame borders, no numbers, no labels, no ground line. Isolated on a fully transparent background.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.

Style: 2D background art for a modern hand-drawn point-and-click adventure game whose characters are cartoon sprites with clean outlines. Clean, confident dark brown outlines of even weight around every shape, flat colour fills with one or two soft cel-shading steps, only a subtle painted texture inside large areas, simple rounded readable shapes, moderate detail, calm planes. Palette at dusk: deep blue-violet sky turning into a band of warm orange at the horizon, teal-blue sea, cool slate and violet shadows; warm amber only for the lit window, the lantern and the lighthouse lamp. Mid values overall, so that a character drawn in front stays readable. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a postcard, not pixel art, no heavy brush texture.
Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
Composition: side view from the eye level of a small character standing on the quay, close to the quay. Flat sea horizon at about 47 % of the image height. The stone quay is a wide, flat, walkable pavement that fills the lower 32 % of the image across the full width, with large calm paving stones; the middle of the quay from 8 % to 72 % of the image width stays completely empty as a walking path. The cottage stands set back on the quay at the left edge, filling the left 20 % of the width, the lit window facing the viewer, the chimney against open sky. The iron lantern on its wooden post stands on the quay at about 74 % of the width, its lantern against the sea and the sky. Barrels, the crate stack and the rope coil stand together at the right edge of the quay, from 80 % to 100 % of the width. Behind the quay, between 25 % and 60 % of the width, the short wooden jetty reaches into the water with the two boats moored at it. The rocky headland rises from the sea on the right; the lighthouse stands on it at about 88 % of the width, its top at about 15 % of the image height. The upper middle of the image is open sky with a few low clouds. Keep a margin of plain sky above the lighthouse and the chimney and plain pavement at the bottom edge (the image will be cropped to 16:9). The lighthouse lamp is only a small glowing spot without any beam, there is no smoke from the chimney, no glow halo around the lantern and no birds: beam, smoke, glow and birds are animated separately in the game.
Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.
